name: gta6-route-replay
detail: Reconstruct a route from a video and a reference map, then scrub the result in a local replay viewer. Four original synthetic captures include ground truth.

name: gta6-capture-dataset
detail: Extract labelled image frames from GTA VI recordings with source hashes and timestamps in JSON Lines.

name: gta6-cheat-ledger
detail: Look up reported GTA VI button combinations and open the evidence behind each entry.

name: gta6-data-catalog
detail: A source-linked collection of six GTA VI regions with validation, search and CSV export.

name: gta6-driving-lab
detail: Train an offline steering estimator on labelled frames from driving footage. A small ridge regression model predicts steering in [-1,1].

name: gta6-event-runtime
detail: Replay ordered events through user-authored scripts. An external scripting-host prototype inspired by ScriptHookVDotNet.

name: gta6-leonida-atlas
detail: Explore six named regions, find the nearest pin and build a multi-stop itinerary.

name: gta6-leonida-guesser
detail: An offline six-round map-fragment guessing game.

name: gta6-mapping-math
detail: Estimate a landmark’s 3D coordinates from camera rays by least squares.

name: gta6-panorama-vr
detail: View a 2:1 equirectangular capture with drag controls and optional WebXR headset rendering. Includes an original horizon scene.

name: gta6-replay-menu
detail: An external, configurable HUD for post-run telemetry. Inspired by the menu interaction of YimMenu and YimMenuV2.

name: gta6-screenshot-locator
detail: Locate the minimap crop of a screenshot on a user-supplied GTA VI atlas. Returns three spatially distinct candidates, correlation scores and pixel coordinates.

name: gta6-session-lab
detail: A standalone multiplayer lobby prototype for experimenting with session state outside GTA VI.

name: gta6-split-timer
detail: A manual browser timer with JSON export, plus an offline visual auto-splitter for recorded runs.

name: Rockstar Games
detail: Grand Theft Auto VI overview, media and announcements.

name: Rockstar Newswire
detail: Publisher news and updates.

name: GTA VI map guide
detail: Independent interactive map and offline guide.

name: Vice Keys Leonida Atlas
detail: Search for Boone Speedway on the approximate community map, then open the walkthrough to find the separate Speedway Trial start.

name: gtamaplib
detail: Camera geometry and mapping tools.

name: Awesome GTA 6
detail: Community-curated GTA VI references.

name: PC Gamer cheat guide
detail: Reported codes and unlock conditions.
